authority: Project system engineer, explicit approval in current conversation
selected_scope: No automatic same-CPI recovery after link interruption or FPGA power/reset loss in the present laboratory configuration
rules: An incomplete or provisional CPI is never accepted as success after interruption; persist the failure/unknown journal and discard provisional output from accepted results.
A CPI already fully validated and durably committed by the host retains that host result; after FPGA state loss, mark device terminal state unknown rather than fabricate an FPGA COMMIT/ABORT.
Do not silently release an FPGA-retained undecided or terminal transaction. Reconcile if safely possible; otherwise stop and require controlled reset/reprogramming before a fresh session and CPI.
A new CPI requires a new session and full IQ upload/readback verification. It shall have a new CPI identity; no partial previous IQ or record set is reused.
The unused RECOVER_UNKNOWN enum and broader R1 proposal are not accepted as implemented recovery.
S05_acceptance: Document the fail-closed stop/manual-controlled-reset design and its limits; S11 tests fault handling and actual board behavior
exclusions: No automatic recovery, no unverified replay, no power-loss guarantee for FPGA volatile terminal state
